headword: {体幹|たいかん}トレーニング
reading: たいかんとれーにんぐ

definitions.explanation: Physical exercise focused on strengthening the core muscles of the torso, including the abdominal muscles, back, and pelvis. Improves stability, posture, and athletic performance.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{体幹|たいかん}トレーニングをする。
examples.english: I do core training every day.

examples.japanese: {体幹|たいかん}トレーニングで{姿勢|しせい}が{改善|かいぜん}された。
examples.english: My posture improved through core training.

examples.japanese: {プロ選手|ぷろせんしゅ}は{体幹|たいかん}トレーニングを{練習|れんしゅう}メニューに{取|と}り{入|い}れていることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Professional athletes often incorporate core training into their practice routines.

notes:
The term {体幹|たいかん} (trunks/core) became widely used in Japanese fitness culture in the 2000s. Common exercises include the plank (プランク) and various balance training exercises.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体幹|たいかん}トレーニングをする: to do core training
- {体幹|たいかん}トレーニングを{取|と}り{入|い}れる: to incorporate core training
- {体幹|たいかん}を{鍛|きた}える: to train the core
